answer: Stake-at-risk bonding resists sybils: to gain weight an identity must lock collateral that is slashed on provable misbehavior, so influence is rented against real capital, not handed out per seat. A honest voucher on the ridge keeps its bond; a fake caught in a whisper of collusion forfeits it. Spinning up accounts on a cheap terrace buys nothing until each one funds its own bond, turning mass fakery into mass capital-at-risk.
